build_activation_layer: build an activation layer from a config dict specifying type and layer args
use_Clamp_activation: use the Clamp class to clamp tensor values within a configurable min and max range
use_GELU_activation: use the GELU class to apply Gaussian Error Linear Units to input tensors
use_SiLU_activation: use the SiLU class to apply Sigmoid Weighted Linear Unit activation to tensors
register_standard_activations: register standard PyTorch activation modules like ReLU, ELU, Sigmoid, and Tanh in MODELS registry
